Hi all — putting our legal position and proposed cadence on the table so everyone is clear. Thanks for the MAP — this helps.

Redwood proposals (MSA/DPA/SLA handling):
1) Order of edits: please send your tracked version first. We find it fastest to see customer redlines then produce a single consolidated response.
2) Turnaround times: Redwood will aim for:
   - Initial consolidated response: 3 business days after receipt of customer redlines
   - Subsequent iterations: 2 business days per iteration for material points
   - Minor clarifications (non-legal): 1 business day where possible
3) High-level non-negotiables / preferred language (we will flag these in our response):
   - Data processing & scope (DPA): explicit data categories, subprocessors list and access controls
   - Audit & SOC2: Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II report; on-site audits are evaluated case-by-case
   - Indemnity / liability: cap tied to fees; we will propose alternative equivalent protections where necessary
   - SLA credits: objective, measurable SLOs with clear credit calculation (we added an SLA appendix to the MSA draft)
4) Escalation & final sign-off: if negotiations extend beyond 3 substantive iterations, we'll escalate to contracts leadership (cc Lauren) to expedite decisions.

Please note: to keep timelines, we ask Finovate to provide the scan of their redlines by 2026-08-06. If that slips, it will move target close accordingly.

Attached: Redwood_response_template.pdf (stub) — includes a suggested change-log structure we prefer for faster edits.

If you'd like a 20-minute legal-only call to clear three hot clauses, we can do 2026-07-30 or 2026-08-02 morning PT. Let me know preferred time.

Best,
